items.title: Most UK brokers lack formal AI strategy despite widespread staff usage, survey shows
items.summary: Insurance Business UK published an article by Moterra examining how broking offices use unapproved public artificial intelligence tools and the resulting compliance questions under existing regulatory frameworks.
